verdict.rationale: Render documents versioning infrastructure as code through a single Blueprint YAML file, review of each change through ephemeral previews, and a Rollbacks capability. That covers version, review, and rollback for deployed services, including workflow tasks and background agents. The evidence does not tie these features specifically to automations or workflows, and the rollback evidence is only a docs heading. Missing for 10: documented versioning, review, and rollback specific to workflows or automations; detail on how rollback works; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Define, deploy, and version your entire architecture with a single YAML file.
Iterate quickly with ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change.
Connect your repo and ship with every push.
